svg.title: Lumen reflections: resolved specular indirect
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. Lumen reflections: resolved specular indirect graph 0001 | ReflectionsResolve pass | source-proved INVALID_LIGHTING sentinel valid radiance (shared tonemap) invalid/empty reflection tile (65024,65024,64512) valid zero radiance non-finite The invalid tile value is not guessed: StochasticLightingCommon.ush:189-193 defines INVALID_LIGHTING = half3(65024.0, 65024.0, 64512.0) and IsLightingValid = !all(V == INVALID_LIGHTING). The resolve writes Center.Lighting = INVALID_LIGHTING for missing lighting (LumenReflectionResolve.usf:111-112). Empty tiles are drawn magenta; a valid zero radiance is drawn black. They are never merged. Resolved radiance is linear RGB; the display scale is the 99th percentile of valid positive luminance for this figure, declared in display.transform.
